setup.title: First-run setup
setup.hero.lead: Four steps, all in the browser. Nothing leaves this machine unless you connect a remote provider.
setup.admin.title: Create the admin account
setup.admin.sub: The admin runs this server: members, models, backups and updates.
setup.admin.email_hint: Used for update notices and password resets when email is set up.
setup.admin.note: Only the first visitor can create the admin. After this step the wizard needs the admin’s login.
setup.admin.foot: You can add two-step login later in Settings.
setup.admin.exists: An admin already exists. Log in to continue the setup.
setup.instance.title: Name your server and choose who can join
setup.instance.sub: You can change all of this later in Admin → Server.
setup.instance.name: Server name
setup.instance.name_hint: Shown in the browser tab, emails and the app header.
setup.instance.url_hint: The address people use to reach this server. Used in invite and reset links.
setup.instance.url_invalid: Enter an address like https://studio.example.org (no path).
setup.instance.signup_hint: Invites always work, even when sign-up is closed.
setup.instance.telemetry_desc: This build sends nothing anywhere unless you connect a provider or link World.
setup.models.title: Connect at least one image model
setup.models.sub_gpu: We found a GPU. You can add API providers too; auto-routing picks between them per job.
setup.models.sub_none: Start a local worker or connect an API provider. The built-in placeholder model works meanwhile.
setup.models.recommend: Recommended local set fits: {models} · {size} GB download
setup.models.recommend_none: This GPU is small for local image models; an API provider is a good fit.
setup.models.worker_no_gpu_desc: CPU workers can run exports, OCR and the placeholder model.
setup.models.no_worker_desc: Run the worker on a machine with a GPU; it appears here within seconds.
setup.models.local_on: Local only mode is on. No prompt or image leaves this server.
setup.provider.local.name: Local worker
setup.provider.local.desc: Your own GPU, nothing leaves the machine
setup.provider.openrouter.name: OpenRouter
setup.provider.openrouter.desc: One key for 30+ image models and text models
setup.provider.openai.name: OpenAI
setup.provider.openai.desc: Structured script generation directly with an OpenAI key
setup.provider.fal.name: fal
setup.provider.vendor.name: OpenAI · Google · xAI
setup.provider.ollama.name: Ollama · local text model
setup.provider.custom.name: Custom connection
setup.provider.custom.desc: OpenAI-compatible, ComfyUI workflow, any HTTP API
setup.finish.title: Check & finish
setup.finish.sub: Everything below can be changed later. Warnings are fine to fix after launch.
setup.check.admin.body: You are signed in as the admin.
setup.check.email.on: SMTP is set up for resets, invites and digests.
setup.check.email.off: Not set up. Admins can still create reset and invite links by hand.
setup.check.workers.off: None online yet. The placeholder model keeps every flow working.
setup.check.url.off: Not set. Links in emails and invites will use the address you opened.
setup.check.local.on: On. Remote providers, the MCP client and World are blocked.
setup.done.title: Your server is ready
